title: Burlan Noteblocks
description: A plugin that removes the need of redstone from noteblock music.
body:
## Burlan Noteblocks (Feel Free to Dm me (kane44hd on discord) if you have play types i can add :3)

## Overview
Burlan Noteblocks is a Minecraft plugin that allows players to select, save, and play sequences of note blocks. Players can create musical sequences by selecting note blocks, saving those selections, and playing them back with adjustable intervals. The plugin supports both one-time playback and continuous looping of selections.

## Commands
1. /burlannoteblocks startselection: Starts the selection mode. Players can left-click note blocks to select them.

2. /burlannoteblocks stopselection <interval>: Stops the selection mode and sets the interval between note playback. The interval must be between 0.1 and 120 seconds.
3. /burlannoteblocks save <name>: Saves the current selection under the specified name. If no selections have been made, an error message will be displayed.
4. /burlannoteblocks play <name1> [name2 ...]: Plays the saved selections specified by name once.
5. /burlannoteblocks playrepeat <name1> [name2 ...]: Plays the saved selections repeatedly.
6. /burlannoteblocks playrepeatstop: Stops any currently repeating playback of selections.

## Data Storage
The plugin saves selections in the plugins/BurlanNoteblocks/ directory. Each selection is stored in a text file with the following format:

interval=<interval_time>

<world_name>,<x>,<y>,<z>

<world_name>,<x>,<y>,<z>

etc
